city_definition: Independent city or named standalone settlement with confirmed internal districts, neighbourhoods and suburbs assigned to its parent city; not a global morphological-urban-area or FUA boundary product
identity: Restore original GeoNames identifiers; otherwise exact normalized name and coordinate matching, or official US place polygon containment

references.municipality_codes: DE and FR ADM4, CH ADM3; country-specific municipal hierarchy, not a universal ADM-level rule

confirmed_parent_rules: GeoNames PPLX with explicit parent populated place
confirmed Chinese urban districts and direct-administered municipalities
review_policy: Keep contradictory country-coordinate-name cases, unverified subcity parents, unresolved identity and coarse administrative-only features in separate audit ledgers
intercity_policy: After mapping both endpoints, same-city events are retained separately and excluded from clean intercity data
tier_policy: Retain annual/career impact tiers separately; never sum overlapping tiers
temporal_policy: Apply the fixed reference geography consistently to the whole 1998-2025 period
data_use: Use clean files for confirmed intercity analyses; consult the review ledger and source scope before changing manuscript sample definitions
